keySentence: She followed the yellow brick road to find the Wizard.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: They met a cowardly lion. He wanted courage. All four walked together. She followed the yellow brick road to find the Wizard.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: A big lion jumped out from the forest with a loud roar. But he was actually scared of almost everything around him. The lion wanted the Wizard to give him courage. She followed the yellow brick road to find the Wizard of Oz. Now Dorothy, Scarecrow, Tin Man, and Lion walked together. They were not afraid because they had each other.
